environment: Node deterministic 240 Hz simulation; no advertisements; legal mobile aim directions
scope: 8 campaign levels and endless; three fixed seeds per strategy. Campaign final eclipse configuration uses 9 starting balls / 5 initial rows.
notes: A turn-cap result marked aim is censored, not a failure.
Search chooses the strongest simulated legal aim; it is evidence of reachability, not measured human win rate.
Older per-shot direction values in source reports were rounded for presentation; success results were simulated with full precision.
